original_question: Mutations in which gene are responsible for the progressive overgrowth disorder named after the Greek sea god who could change his shape?

final_qi.question: Mutations in which gene are responsible for the progressive overgrowth disorder named after the Greek sea god who could change his shape?
final_qi.long_answer: Proteus syndrome — a progressive, mosaic overgrowth disorder named after the shape-shifting Greek sea god Proteus — is caused by a somatic activating mutation in the AKT1 gene (most commonly the c.49G>A, p.E17K substitution). This gain-of-function mutation hyperactivates the PI3K–AKT signaling pathway, leading to the asymmetric, segmental overgrowth characteristic of the condition.
